verdict.rationale: Running untrusted code in sandboxes is a fair question for a cloud compute platform, so the axis applies. The pack only shows adjacent features: per-PR preview environments, which a Render article frames as agent sandboxes, and short-lived one-off service instances. Neither is documented as a hardware-isolated (e.g. microVM) sandbox for untrusted code, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can run untrusted code in hardware-isolated, disposable sandboxes
